events.asset: COMP360 (Compass Pathways' synthetic psilocybin): the first Phase 3 topline readout in treatment-resistant depression
events.title: Compass Pathways reports its first COMP360 Phase 3 topline readout
events.proposition: Compass Pathways reports the topline primary-endpoint result, in either direction, of the first Phase 3 trial of COMP360 (synthetic psilocybin) in treatment-resistant depression.
events.criterion: TRUE on the date of the first Compass Pathways topline press release, ClinicalTrials.gov results posting or peer-reviewed publication that reports the primary endpoint result, in either direction, of a Phase 3 trial of COMP360 (synthetic psilocybin) in treatment-resistant depression. A Phase 2 result, an enrollment or trial-start announcement, a guidance statement on the expected readout date, an interim safety report and a conference abstract without the primary estimate do not count. Resolution source: Compass Pathways press releases, with ClinicalTrials.gov results as the secondary source. FALSE at the deadline when no such report is dated by then.

resolution_source.name: Compass Pathways topline press releases; ClinicalTrials.gov results as the secondary source

readings: 'Readout' reads as the sponsor's first public report of the trial's primary endpoint result, in either direction.

related_timeline.event: Nature Medicine publishes MAPP1 phase 3: MDMA-assisted therapy beat placebo-with-therapy on CAPS-5 in 90 patients with severe chronic PTSD.
related_timeline.key_number: 67% vs 32% no longer met PTSD criteria; p<0.0001

related_timeline.event: American Journal of Psychiatry publishes double-blind sham-controlled RCT of Stanford Neuromodulation Therapy (5-day accelerated iTBS) in treatment-resistant depression.
Canada Gazette publishes SOR/2021-271, restoring Special Access Program requests for restricted drugs such as psilocybin and MDMA for patients with serious conditions.
Karuna reports positive phase 3 EMERGENT-2: KarXT beat placebo on PANSS total score at week 5 in acute schizophrenia.
FDA approves Auvelity (dextromethorphan-bupropion), the first oral NMDA receptor antagonist for MDD, with labeled symptom improvement from week 1.
related_timeline.key_number: first new oral MDD mechanism in 60+ years

related_timeline.event: NEJM publishes Compass phase 2b: a single 25 mg COMP360 psilocybin dose beat 1 mg control on MADRS at week 3 in 233 TRD patients.
related_timeline.key_number: -6.6 MADRS vs 1 mg at week 3; p<0.001

related_timeline.event: Colorado voters approve Proposition 122 (Natural Medicine Health Act), decriminalizing five plant psychedelics and authorizing regulated psilocybin healing centers.
Relmada's esmethadone fails a second large phase 3 depression trial two months after the October 2022 RELIANCE III miss; shares fall further.
OHA adopts final administrative rules implementing Measure 109 psilocybin services; license applications open January 2, 2023.
Oregon Psilocybin Services begins accepting applications for manufacturer, service center, facilitator and laboratory licenses.
TGA announces final decision to reschedule psilocybin (TRD) and MDMA (PTSD) to Schedule 8 for TGA-authorised psychiatrists, effective 1 July 2023.
atai lays off about 30% of staff and reviews its pipeline two months after the PCN-101 (R-ketamine) phase 2a miss.

events.asset: COMP360 (Compass Pathways' synthetic psilocybin): Phase 3 programme in treatment-resistant depression
events.title: A COMP360 (psilocybin) Phase 3 trial in treatment-resistant depression meets its primary endpoint
events.proposition: A Phase 3 trial of COMP360 (synthetic psilocybin) in treatment-resistant depression reports its prespecified primary efficacy endpoint met with statistical significance.
events.criterion: TRUE on the date of the first Compass Pathways topline press release, ClinicalTrials.gov results posting or peer-reviewed publication that reports a Phase 3 trial of COMP360 (synthetic psilocybin) in treatment-resistant depression as having met its prespecified primary efficacy endpoint with statistical significance against the control arm, as reported by the sponsor. A Phase 2 result, a secondary endpoint, an interim analysis, a long-term follow-up report and a conference abstract without the primary estimate do not count. Resolution source: Compass Pathways topline press releases, with ClinicalTrials.gov results as the secondary source. FALSE at the deadline when the first reported Phase 3 primary endpoint missed significance, or when no Phase 3 primary result is reported.

resolution_source.name: Compass Pathways topline press releases; ClinicalTrials.gov results as the secondary source

readings: 'A successful phase three' reads as the prespecified primary efficacy endpoint met with statistical significance.

events.asset: Transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) devices, any manufacturer: authorization for a psychotic disorder indication (including auditory hallucinations)
events.title: FDA authorizes a TMS device for psychosis
events.proposition: The FDA authorizes a transcranial magnetic stimulation device for a psychotic disorder indication, including auditory hallucinations.
events.criterion: TRUE on the decision date, in the FDA 510(k), De Novo or PMA database, of a marketing authorization dated after 2026-03-23 for a transcranial magnetic stimulation device whose indications-for-use statement names a psychotic disorder or a symptom of psychosis (for example schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder, auditory hallucinations or auditory verbal hallucinations). A breakthrough device designation, a published trial, a professional-society guideline and off-label clinical use are not an authorization. Resolution source: the FDA device databases (510(k), De Novo, PMA). FALSE at the deadline when no such authorization is listed.

resolution_source.name: FDA 510(k), De Novo and PMA databases

readings: 'that's gonna include psychosis' reads as a TMS device authorized for a psychotic disorder indication; auditory hallucinations count as a psychotic symptom.
'and other conditions' names no countable set, so only the psychosis indication is coded.

related_timeline.event: Canada Gazette publishes SOR/2021-271, restoring Special Access Program requests for restricted drugs such as psilocybin and MDMA for patients with serious conditions.
Oregon Psilocybin Services begins accepting applications for manufacturer, service center, facilitator and laboratory licenses.
DEA publishes proposed rules on telemedicine prescribing of controlled substances after the COVID PHE, including in-person visit requirements and 30-day limits.

related_timeline.entity: Sens. Booker and Paul; Reps. Mace and Dean
related_timeline.event: Breakthrough Therapies Act reintroduced to let DEA move FDA breakthrough-designated Schedule I drugs such as MDMA and psilocybin to Schedule II; bill later dies in committee.
NEJM publishes ELEKT-D: subanesthetic IV ketamine was noninferior to ECT in 403 nonpsychotic treatment-resistant depression patients.
FDA issues draft guidance 'Psychedelic Drugs: Considerations for Clinical Investigations' (docket FDA-2023-D-1987); comments due August 25, 2023.
FDA approves Zurzuvae (zuranolone) as the first oral treatment for postpartum depression and issues a CRL for the MDD indication, requiring more studies.
FDA warns patients and providers about risks of compounded ketamine products, including oral formulations used at home for psychiatric disorders via telemedicine.
FDA grants Breakthrough Therapy designation to MM120 (LSD D-tartrate) for generalized anxiety disorder.
FDA grants Breakthrough Therapy designation to CYB003 (deuterated psilocybin analog) as adjunctive treatment for major depressive disorder.
FDA Psychopharmacologic Drugs Advisory Committee votes against MDMA-assisted therapy for PTSD, citing functional unblinding, missing safety data and site misconduct.
Advisory committee votes 2-9 that MDMA-assisted therapy is not shown effective for PTSD and 1-10 that benefits do not outweigh risks.
